thomas-wingfold-curate-v1:
Volume one of George MacDonald's Thomas Wingfold, Curate begins with Helen Lingard watching a November storm from her window. Wind takes every chimney for an organ pipe, and woods moan like a sea. Helen delayed her park walk after writing a long letter to Leopold at Cambridge.

She is healthy, sensible, and seldom merry, yet weather and dress plainly affect her mood. The fireside grows more attractive as rain threatens outside. This record's opening is identical to the opening of the record named without a volume marker, so readers meet the same chapter twice in the library.
